responsibility: Implements the core optinfo data model used to capture optimization diagnostics and related dump content as structured records rather than plain text. It owns optinfo_item lifetime, mapping between optinfo kinds and dump flags, accumulation of typed items within an optinfo, re-emission support for opt_problem-style diagnostics through dump_context, and the predicate for whether active destinations require preserved inlining metadata.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for the optinfo group: it defines optinfo and optinfo_item lifetime management, kind-to-dump-flag mapping, re-emission behavior, and the inlining-info predicate. Unlike optinfo.h, which declares the structured record/item classes and enums, this file contains their executable behavior.
